newsitem.title: USA: General employment to open 36 new offices.
newsitem.headline: General employment to open 36 new offices.

text.p: General Employment Enterprises Inc plans to open 36 new branch offices during the next three years, chairman Herb Imhoff said in remarks prepared for delivery to shareholders.
Imhoff said the company expects to open eight new offices in its current fiscal year ending September 30, 1997, another 12 during 1998 and 16 new branches during 1999.

He said 24 of the new units are expected to operate as full-service branches and the remaining 12 as Triad Personnel branches, focusing their staffing efforts strictly on information technology contract temporary project assignments.

In responding to questions concerning General Employment's outlook for 1997, Imhoff said, "While we don't make public projections and predictions, we really do believe we're poised for significant growth throughout fiscal 1997 ... we believe it could be a back-to-back record-setting performance for the year."

He added that the personnel placement company hopes to identify "one or two private staffing firms" as candidates for acquisition during the next three years, but its primary focus will be on expanding through internal growth.
